name: Sky's Offroad Design & Sky Manufacturing
old_description: These springs boast a 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place finish in The Ultra4 4600 Class against 4-links and V8 power.  We have continually tweaked these to perfection through rigorous miles of trail and desert racing since 2004!
about:
Sky's Offroad Design & Sky Manufacturing operates from Springfield, Oregon. The company traces its roots to 2004, when founder Sky began developing and racing suspension components in the Ultra4 4600 Class, earning first, second, and third-place finishes against four-link and V8-powered competitors. That competition history continues to drive product development today.

The business designs and manufactures off-road suspension and steering systems for Ford F-Series and Bronco (1980–1997), Toyota, Chevrolet, Suzuki, and Dodge platforms. Core processes include CNC machining of 6061-T6 aluminum rotor hats and other components, welding of weld-in bungs and brackets, and assembly of kits that combine Timken unit bearings, alloy hardware, and custom-fabricated brackets. The product line spans leaf-spring kits, coil-over conversion kits, four-link kits, crossover steering conversions, brake kits, motor mounts, and a range of small hardware items.

Customers are primarily off-road enthusiasts and racers building or upgrading vehicles for trail, desert, and competitive use. The company sells direct through its e-commerce site, shipping complete kits and individual components to builders working on everything from 1990s Ford OBS trucks to late-model Toyota 4Runners and Suzuki Samurais.

The operation was born from a desire to prove parts on the race course before offering them to the public. Sky states that every design is "continually tweaked to perfection through rigorous miles of trail and desert racing," a philosophy that ties product validation directly to competition results.
